stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> AdmittingBaton: authenticated RepairActivationBatonV1
    AdmittingBaton --> Unsupported: managed-local provenance, enrollment, capability, or slot guarantee absent
    AdmittingBaton --> BatonDurable: journal fsync and durable acceptance
    BatonDurable --> SlotsVerified: candidate and previous whole-slot hashes verified
    SlotsVerified --> QuiescingCurrent: BootstrapCommandV1 BeginActivation
    QuiescingCurrent --> AbortedBeforeSwitch: current generation cannot quiesce before selector change
    QuiescingCurrent --> CandidateSelected: current tree empty and candidate selector intent durable
    CandidateSelected --> CandidateLaunching: candidate selector observed and verified
    CandidateLaunching --> AwaitingCandidateIdentity: fresh ProcessGenerationV1 launched
    AwaitingCandidateIdentity --> CandidateVerifying: nonce hash generation and plan handshake pass
    CandidateVerifying --> Verified: health and focused CapabilityOutcomeV1 pass
    Verified --> ResultAvailable: protected BootstrapResultV1 ActivatedVerified durable

    CandidateSelected --> RollingBack: launch fails or helper recovers destructive phase
    CandidateLaunching --> RollingBack: spawn crash timeout or identity mismatch
    AwaitingCandidateIdentity --> RollingBack: startup deadline or wrong generation
    CandidateVerifying --> RollingBack: health timeout failed or missing verification
    RollingBack --> PreviousSelected: candidate tree empty and previous selector restored
    PreviousSelected --> PreviousRelaunching: previous slot reverified
    PreviousRelaunching --> RolledBack: fresh rollback ProcessGenerationV1 handshakes
    RolledBack --> ResultAvailable: protected BootstrapResultV1 RolledBack durable
    RollingBack --> ManualRecoveryRequired: previous corrupt restore fails or data incompatible
    PreviousRelaunching --> ManualRecoveryRequired: previous cannot relaunch or handshake

    Unsupported --> ResultAvailable
    AbortedBeforeSwitch --> ResultAvailable
    ManualRecoveryRequired --> ResultAvailable
    ResultAvailable --> [*]: expected next core reads receipt

    [*] --> Recovering: nonterminal journal found at helper start
    Recovering --> BatonDurable: accepted only and no selector effect
    Recovering --> RollingBack: switch launch watchdog or verification phase interrupted
    Recovering --> ResultAvailable: terminal receipt and journal head verify
    Recovering --> ManualRecoveryRequired: chain selector generation or slot proof ambiguous

data.title: Durable activation, watchdog, rollback, relaunch, result, and crash-recovery phases
